prompt.en: The fleur-de-lys takes its name from which flower?
prompt.fr: La fleur de lys tire son nom de quelle fleur?

explanation.en: The name means lily flower. A French king is said to have adopted it in the year 496, and it stood for French royalty for over a thousand years, New France included.
explanation.fr: Le nom désigne la fleur du lys. On dit qu'un roi de France l'a adoptée en l'an 496, et elle a représenté la royauté française pendant plus de mille ans, y compris la Nouvelle-France.

source.quote: It is said that the lily flower (“fleur-de-lys”) was adopted by the French king in the year 496. It became the symbol of French royalty for more than 1,000 years, including the colony of New France.

verification.evidence: It is said that the lily flower (“fleur-de-lys”) was adopted by the French king in the year 496.
